title: Beef Bourguignon
description: A French classic beef stew cooked in red wine with a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, beef broth, and curry powder to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Skim the fat from the surface of the stew and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme, if desired.
